 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as ‘ Mall 35 ’ comprising of inter alia hotel apartments restaurants, and commercial shops located at Plot No. 35/A, Police Station Road, Rawalpindi (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and the F loor P lan of the Project and agrees to purchase the hotel apartment , as described in Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”) , along with leaseback to and buyback by the Developer with respect thereto ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer and to take on lease or buy back the same from the Buyer, on the terms and conditions of this Agreement . 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “ Buyer ”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale , purchase and leaseback of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of this Agreement ( “Agreement” ) : 
 Description of Purchased Unit 
 This Agreement to Sell 
 General Terms and Conditions 
 Nominees 
 Leaseback Agreement, as may be renewed from time to time in ac cordance with the terms thereof 
 Attachment A : Payment Plan 
 Attachment B : Purchased Unit Floor Plan 
 Any other document forming part of this Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions , followed by the Payment Plan , and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming this Agreement . 
 
 
 
 BUYER ’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read and understood , and agrees to comply with this Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer , each such Buyer ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into this Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to this Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between t he Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement may be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means this Agreement to Sell, along with these General Terms and Conditions, as well as all documents enumerate d in Clause 2 of this Agreement to Sell, as may be amended or supplemented by the Developer from time to time at its sole discretion. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means this Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3. 2 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in this Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies , and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that do not form part of any given Unit. 
 
 Commencement Date means the date on which the Hotel Management Company launches the hotel for the Project, in accordance with the Permitted Use. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial , capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority, including the O ffice of the Cantonment Board Rawalpindi , Office of the Military Estates Officer Rawalpindi, and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or this Agreement . 
 
 Completion or Estimated C ompletion D ate 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of the possession to the Buyer , subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause 4 ( Construction of Purchased Unit ) of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers has the meaning assigned to it in the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project. 
 
 Developer means Mall 35 , a partnership firm with its office at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore . 
 
 Down Payment means the amount paid by the Buyer under this Agreement to Sell , equal to thirty percent ( 30% ) of the Purchas e Price (defined below) of the Purchased Unit , as shown in the Payment Plan . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment or instalment in the Payment Plan is required to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer in the designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 2 .1 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Hotel Management Company 
 means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the maintenance, operation or management of a hotel with respect to the Units including the Purchased Unit. 
 
 Insta l ment Payment means any payment to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan (defined below). For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause s 3.2 and 3.3 , include any applicable Adjusted Amount . 
 
 Lease back Agreement means the lease back agreement executed by and between the Developer and the Buyer whereby the Buyer has leased back the Purchased Unit to the Developer pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Agreement this Agreement . 
 
 Lease Period shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Nominee means such person , as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer under this Agreement to Sell to the legal heirs in the event of demise of the Buyer . 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Attachment A , setting out the Due Date, qua ntum and schedule of Instal ment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the operation, management, and maintenance of a luxury hotel by the Hotel Management Company. 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Mall 35 ’ , approved and sanctioned by the Office of the Cantonment Board , Rawalpindi, being constructed and developed by the Developer on Plot No. 35/A, Police Station Road, Rawalpindi . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount identified i n the Payment Plan as the p urchase price of the Purchased Unit payable by the Buyer in accordance with the Payment Plan, together with any Adjusted Amount which may be payable under Clause 3. 2 as consideration for the sale and transfer of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the specific furnished hotel apartment , as shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase and lease to the Developer pursuant to th is Agreement . 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location , as shown in Attachment B to this Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Rent has the meaning assigned to it in the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 Rules means such rules, as amended from time to time, as may be framed by t he Developer , and/or the Hotel Management Company setting out the Buyer’s rights and obligations in relation to the lease of Purchased Unit. 
 
 Taxes means any federal, provincial or local taxes or levies payable on any component used for the construction or lease of the Purchased Unit (including the Component Materials) or, where the context permits, applicable on the sale or lease thereof , as may be prescribed or levied from time to time by any Competent Authority . 
 
 Unit means any one or more hotel apartment (s) in the Project, including the Purchased Unit. 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in this Agreement to: 
 
 An Article, Clause, attachment , or paragraph are references to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of this Agreement or the relevant document comprising this Agreement; 
 
 Any headings in this Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad , Pakistan; 
 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of this Agreement or any part of this Agreement; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any U nit by t he Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of the Developer ’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Project , to construct the Project and to sell the Purchased Unit and that it has received requisite approvals from Competent Authorities for the development and construction of the Project . Further, the Developer agrees to construct the Project and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, strictly in accordance with this Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 PA YMENT 
 
 The consideration for construction and payment of R ent of the Purchased Unit by t he Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Insta l ment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date along with any applicable Adjusted Amount such as to constitute the entire Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit , as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Attachment A of this Agreement ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable (if any) membership and other fees, taxes, levies, or any other charges whatsoever with respect to the sale , lease and buyback of the Purchased Unit, in accordance with law ; 
 
 The Buyer agreeing to abide by all Rules and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable to the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall remain fixed under this Agreement. However, the Purchase Price may be adjusted if, between the date of signing of this Agreement and the Completion date, there is an increase in the price of Component Material, as per the price indices published by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics insofar as applicable, or if there is an increase in applicable Taxes or any new Taxes. In this event, the Developer will make every reasonable effort for the Purchase Price to remain unaffected and ensure that any impact on the remaining Purchase Price is adjusted in a fair and reasonable manner (“ Adjusted Amount ”). 
 
 The adjustment in the Purchase Price under Clause 3. 2 shall be to the extent of increase in the price of Component Material and Taxes only, and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount, which shall be deemed a part of the Payment Plan and the Purchase Price, at the time of possession upon completion of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/ or Adjusted Amount on its Du e Date or within thirty (30) days thereof , without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges , conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise howsoever , all of which shall be borne by the Buyer . Such payment shall be affected by one of the following means on or before the relevant Due Date , and the Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of this Agreement , entitling the Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 11.1 : 
 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “ Mall 35 ” ; 
 OR 
 With written notice to the Developer, by direct transfer or deposit into the account designated below , or such other designated bank account of the Developer as may be notified in writing :

 Account No: 1426394  
 Bank: JS Bank Limited

 Pursuant to this Agreement , the Buyer has made the Down Payment, receipt of which t he Developer hereby acknowledges. In case the funds are not realised on the date of signing of this Agreement to Sell, this A greement shall be deemed null and void.
